turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm setting up the systemd unit for lloyd-backend. Can you check the config syntax?
Sure, please share the [Service] section or the full unit file.
It's standard. I just added lloyd-backend is configured with startretries=3 and exitcodes=0 to handle those transient network glitches we had last week.
Understood. That should help it survive brief connectivity drops.
Yeah. Also, did you order the new mechanical keyboard yet?
I placed the order for the keycaps this morning, but the base unit is backordered.
No worries. Just let me know when it ships.
Will do. I'll keep an eye on the tracking email.
Lloyd, I'm looking at the logs from last night. It seems lloyd-backend was STOPPED without an intentional stop.
That sounds unexpected. Do you see any OOM killer messages or segfaults in the syslog?
No, just the exit signal. Weird. Anyway, did you get that pizza recommendation?
Yes, the place on 5th Street has great reviews for their gluten-free options.
Perfect. Let's go there Friday if the server stays up.
Sounds like a plan. I'll add it to your calendar.
Thanks. Back to the server, I'll try restarting it manually now.
Okay, let me know if the issue persists after the restart.
